Who We Are

17 years in human capital made Humantic Digital what it is today.

Built on a 17-year foundation of international joint ventures across the United Kingdom and the GCC — including our former role as the exclusive MENA educational arm for the British College City Oxford delivering executive educational and development journey along one on one counselling on 5 continents.

Trusted across

Vision 2030 Strategic Partnership

Co-Investment Framework

Humantic Digital is a MISA-licensed investment entity operating a dedicated, Vision 2030-aligned KSA enablement programme. We co-fund strategic organisational capability programmes across key institutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Investment Record in Saudi Arabia throughout 2023-2026

Humantic Digital has co-invested in and funded human-capability development programmes, including fully funded British professional certification programmes for qualifying Saudi institutions and beneficiaries.

To date, this investment and programme activity includes:

  • 140 programme days delivered over 7 months across 5 healthcare institutions associated with the Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs and hospitals owned by His Majesty King Salman.
  • More than 540 programme days delivered to numerous Saudi-owned institutions Kingdom-wide, including the Royal Commission for AlUla, SGS, KSAU, UAQ – Masar Destination and more, covering Riyadh, Jeddah, Khobar, Dammam and AlUla.

Humantic AI – Align

Core features: what the team actually sees

HumanticDIGITAL
Shared Team Board

One board for the whole team, grouped by project or priority. Every card shows its owner, due date and status.

One Owner per Task

Every task has one accountable owner. Align AI flags unassigned work and suggests who should take it.

AI Capture Inbox

Forward an email or paste a note. Align AI drafts a clear task with an owner and due date for one-tap approval.

Smart Priority Ranking

Each person's list is ranked by real urgency, dependencies and objectives, so the most important request wins.

Follow-Up & Waiting-For Tracker

Replies, approvals and handovers owed by others are tracked automatically, with polite reminders sent for you.

Meeting-to-Action

Paste meeting notes and Align AI pulls out decisions, owners and deadlines onto the board.

A Thread on Every Card

Comment, tag a colleague or ask for a status update on the card, in one searchable thread.

Calm Communication

Suggests a calm, respectful version of sensitive or overdue follow-ups, so hard conversations start well.

Weekly Reset

Every Sunday evening, each person and manager gets an AI-built review of what closed, what is stuck and what is due.

Productivity & Wellbeing Index

A workload and wellbeing view for each person, and a team view so managers can spot overload before burnout.

Protecting Performance and the People Behind It

Our AI productivity and wellbeing metrics sit side by side in Humantic AI - Align, giving leaders the full picture of organisational health. Backed by confidential pulse checks, weekly resets and Humantic 1:1 advisory, leaders get the early insight to:

  1. Spot burnout before performance drops.
  2. Keep top talent at their best, before disengagement sets in.
  3. See what is slowing each person down, through individualised performance derailers.

Presenter · Presentation 1

Live board · sample view✦ AI that gets your vibe
Confidence & presence0%
  • Stands grounded and open, weight balanced
  • Opens with a calm, natural expression
  • Shares eye contact across the whole room
  • Uses pauses on purpose, not to fill gaps
  • Recovers quickly and calmly from a slip
  • Stays composed when interrupted or challenged
Voice0%
  • Can be heard clearly at the back of the room
  • Pace lets the audience follow every point
  • Words are clear and well articulated
  • Tone rises and falls to stress key points
  • Energy matches the message
  • Few filler words (um, ah, like, so)
Gesture & movement0%
  • Gestures support and illustrate the words
  • Hands are relaxed and visible
  • Moves with purpose, no pacing or swaying
  • Facial expression fits the message
  • Faces the audience, not the screen
  • Uses the space to connect with the room

  • Opens with a clear point or question
  • One key message the audience could repeat
  • Turns numbers into an insight, not a list
  • Charts and slides are easy to read
  • Closes with a clear next step
Handling the room0%
  • Listens fully before answering
  • Answers questions briefly and directly
  • Handles an unknown answer honestly
  • Stays calm under a hard or hostile question
  • Returns to the key message after questions

Communicate with awareness, present with impact.

How every presentation is evaluated, live.

Each participant presents on the Present with Intelligence board: the presenter at the centre, every evaluation point linked to what the audience sees and hears, with the live score and AI evaluation alongside.

Over three days, participants work on their own reports and dashboards, ideally the ones built in the Excel programme, so what they practise is what they present next.

  1. Confidence and presence
  2. Voice
  3. Gesture and movement
  4. Story and data
  5. Body language
